semantics.inverse_ballot: The SPIR-V instruction requires uniform Value. Per-invocation mask values now use guarded dword selection and shift-and-test; no driver or game condition. Upper subgroup lanes>=64 return false, matching the padded upper64 mask bits.
semantics.write_lane: Write selected lane only, preserve old values elsewhere; compute logical lane uses LocalInvocationIndex%64. Dynamic lane selections no longer enter immediate-only elimination.
semantics.counter_address: CIK base align(M0>>16,4)+OFFSET0; counter index=OFFSET0>>2. Key comparison uses checked physical byte offset so alternative encodings alias. Out-of-range requests fail transactionally; wrapping is not guessed.
semantics.seed_lifetime: Synchronized 64KiB GDS snapshot supplies only requested addresses, deduplicated; no presumed-zero seed. Refresh between dispatches because ordinary GDS/CP-DMA can change these values. New helper remains unwired to a real continuation.
semantics.live_exchange_return: Captured original IR uses the old Exchange result in later address arithmetic; its previous value cannot be replaced with zero.
semantics.donor: Retained donor/pr-ds-ordered-count uses GDS base plus index*4; its unsafe GPU spin ordering is not imported.

curl --fail --location --retry 3 \
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chreece/shadPS4/$RUNNER/scripts/shadps4-universal-two-game-check.sh" \
  -o "$run_dir/run.sh"

  "$run_dir/run.sh" | sha256sum --check -
